about: A passage of code in a dark panel, each kind of token in its own ink, headed by what the code is and whatever control a page puts beside it.

file.about: A component file under its name, with `CodeBlock.Copy` in the header's control. The control reads the code off the root, so the passage is written once, and takes its two marks from the page. The panel is dark whatever the page is, so the same block reads the same on every page.
file.title: A file

languages.about: The highlighter knows the language from its name and colours the passage on its first paint. A language it does not know is set as plain text.
languages.title: Languages

modes.about: The panel is dark by default whatever the page is in, so a block reads the same on every page. `mode="light"` draws it light on any page, and `mode="inherit"` leaves it in the page's own mode. Toggle the page to see the third one follow.
modes.title: Modes

plain.about: A passage with no language named is set as it was written, in the code role, with no token coloured.
plain.title: Plain text

sizes.about: The two sizes the code role is set at. The header reads a step down from the code.
sizes.title: Sizes

title: Code block
